features.name: Oral Tradition
features.description: When you adopt this path at 3rd level, you gain proficiency in History and Performance. If you already have proficiency in one of these skills, your proficiency bonus is doubled for ability checks using that skill.

features.name: Battle Fervor
features.description: Starting at 3rd level, when you enter a rage, you can expend one additional daily use of rage to allow a number of willing creatures equal to half your proficiency bonus (minimum 1) within 30 feet to enter a rage as well. They must see and hear you. Each gains the Rage benefits and restrictions. A target's rage ends early if it can no longer see or hear you.

features.name: Lorekeeper
features.description: At 6th level, you can enter a trance to cast *augury*, *comprehend languages*, or *identify* as a ritual only. After casting in this way, you can't use this feature again until you finish a short or long rest.

features.name: Bolstering Chant
features.description: At 10th level, when you end your rage as a bonus action, you regain HP equal to your barbarian level × 3. Alternatively, if other creatures are also raging via Battle Fervor, you and each affected creature regain HP equal to your barbarian level + CHA modifier.

features.name: Thunderous Oratory
features.description: At 14th level, while raging, your attacks deal an extra 2d6 thunder damage. Creatures raging via Battle Fervor deal an extra 1d6 thunder damage with weapon attacks. When you or a Battle Fervor creature scores a critical hit with a melee weapon, the target must succeed on a STR save (DC 8 + prof bonus + CHA mod) or be pushed up to 10 ft and knocked prone.
